next_action.title: Async persistent diary controller
next_action.scope: Implement first bounded async controller slice using SQLiteDiary contract and existing prepareEntry/diaryView, commit-before-render, revision conflicts, dates and errors. Test with actual local SQLite when possible. Do not connect to fake native driver or claim persistence of current HTML; preserve existing preview. Plan durable goals and backup scaling before release, then M03C2 UI integration and M04 native bridge/build.
acceptance: Confirmed storage commit precedes visible success; failed write preserves previous state
Shared domain and revision semantics; stale date responses cannot overwrite current view
Real local integration tests or explicitly scoped test evidence; device/native NOT_RUN
next_action.rollback: Revert scoped code; never destructively roll back user data.
